quest.title: Contingencies
quest.description: Huffman is currently so busy with matters concerning the fallen meteorites, that he barely has time for anything else...
quest.rewards_formatted: Fading Star's Might x20, Primogem x40, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. Please refrain from leaving the city during this time, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Now, I believe that you've seen those fallen meteorites as well.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: For some reason, they've started falling at a greater rate than before, and it's become more dangerous out there in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: All sorts of matters are cropping up within the city, almost more than the Knights can handle. All this, at a time when we'd just discovered Treasure Hoarder activity near the city...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Those fellows would do anything for a little Mora. I fear that they'll try to take advantage of this situation...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: If you're willing, Traveler, could you help us chase those thieves off?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: This should be a task for the Knights, but I fear that we can't spare the people to settle this matter. Can you help us?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: You have my thanks. I'm sorry, I know it's not the best look for us to be asking you to help us in these circumstances.

choices.text: The Treasure Hoarders aren't scared of the meteorites?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Hmph. I'd wager that those crooks fear nothing, as long as they can get their hands on some Mora.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: You have my thanks. I'm sorry, I know it's not the best look for us to be asking you to help us in these circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Have you succeeded in beating back those Treasure Hoarders?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure did.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Wonderful. You've been a great help.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Hopefully, those Treasure Hoarders will take a hint from this lesson and stop eyeing Mondstadt up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well then, if there's nothing else...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Um, so, please hold on a moment... There is something else I need your help with.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: In truth, we've received a plenitude of reports about abnormal monsters during this period.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: These reports mention that the meteorites have caused the monsters to become especially aggressive.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: The city's defenses are sufficiently stalwart, so there's no reason to worry there. But one such meteorite has landed right beside Springvale...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Springvale is home to many hunters, and we've sent knights to reinforce them, but the terrain is truly difficult to police.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: If any monsters were to enter the town, things could get disastrous...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Could you head over to Springvale and help us investigate the status of the monsters there?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: I'll leave it in your capable hands, then. I will do what I can to send some knights over to assist you.

choices.text: What's the situation over in Springvale?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: To be frank, things don't look good. We already have our hands full dealing with the meteorites' aftermath. But we also need to guard against monsters and the Treasure Hoarders...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: It's almost impossible to handle so many things at once...

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: I'm sorry, but I'm leaving this in your hands. In the meantime, I will try to send knights over to aid you.

talks.objective: Head close to Springvale to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Aaaah! D—Don't come any...

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Eh? Y—You're not a monster. Wh—Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the status on those monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: The monsters? What is there to ask? I was just running from them, that's what!

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: They were right there, a whole bunch of them, looking like they might attack the town.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: If I hadn't run so fast, I'd have been a goner...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where are those beasts?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Right next to the town. A few steps around the corner and you'll see them.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: You should get to shelter as well. I'll rest here for a while, and then I'll go warn everyone in town.

talks.objective: Destroy all the monster camps near Springvale

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Huh? It's you, again? What were you doing this whole time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Defeating all the monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Defeating all the... What? Just you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Ugh, I daren't look. If they see me, I'd be done for!

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: I'll just report what you've said to the Knights — never mind if it's true or not.

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Th—They'll have some way to check if you've beaten all those monsters, I'm sure.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: How's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Springvale is safe.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: That's great... I was honestly worried that we might not be able to spare anyone to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. You've really helped us out this time. Please take these as a token of our esteem.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Meteorites, monsters... I can only hope that nothing truly messy happens.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: How do you do, Honorary Knight? Please, do your utmost to remain within the city limits during this time.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Now, I believe that you've seen those fallen meteorites as well.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: For some reason, they've started falling at a greater rate than before, and it's become more dangerous out there in the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: All sorts of matters are cropping up within the city, almost more than the Knights can handle. All this, at a time when we'd just discovered Treasure Hoarder activity near the city...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Those fellows would do anything for a little Mora. I fear that they'll try to take advantage of this situation...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: If you're willing, Traveler, could you help us chase those thieves off?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Spoken well, Honorary Knight. I'll leave it in your able hands.

choices.text: Aren't the Treasure Hoarders scared of the meteorites?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Hmph. I'd wager that those crooks fear nothing, as long as they can get their hands on some Mora.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: You have my thanks. I'm sorry, I know it reflects ill on us to be asking for your help in such circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: I suppose it can be considered some small consolation that no meteorites have come down within the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Meteorites, monsters and the Treasure Hoarders. It's really pouring, isn't it...

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: I have to warn everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: Did you really defeat all those monsters by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Timid Morrow
dialogues.text: If that's so, you're really strong. Better than the Knights of Favonius, even.
